about.title: About Ali Air Conditioning & Refrigeration
about.subtitle: Your Trusted Partner for AC and Refrigeration Services in Saudi Arabia
about.intro: Since our establishment, we've been dedicated to providing exceptional air conditioning and refrigeration services throughout Medina and surrounding areas.
about.storyPara1: Ali Air Conditioning & Refrigeration (مؤسسة علي للتكييف والتبريد) was founded with a simple mission: to provide reliable, professional, and affordable AC and refrigeration services to homes and businesses across Saudi Arabia.
about.storyPara2: What started as a small operation has grown into a trusted name in the industry, serving thousands of satisfied customers. Our commitment to excellence and customer satisfaction has remained unwavering throughout our journey.
about.storyPara3: Today, we're proud to offer 24/7 emergency services, expert installations, comprehensive maintenance programs, and quick repairs for all major brands of air conditioning units, washing machines, and refrigeration equipment.
about.missionText: To deliver exceptional air conditioning and refrigeration services that exceed customer expectations through expertise, reliability, and dedication to quality.
about.visionText: To be the most trusted and preferred AC and refrigeration service provider in Saudi Arabia, known for our technical excellence and customer care.
about.whyChooseDesc: Trusted experts delivering fast, reliable, and affordable appliance care
about.expertTechniciansDesc: Our certified technicians have years of experience and undergo continuous training to stay updated with the latest technologies.
about.availabilityDesc: AC emergencies don't wait for business hours. We're available 24/7 to handle your urgent repair and maintenance needs.
about.qualityGuaranteeDesc: We stand behind our work with comprehensive warranties and use only genuine parts for all repairs and installations.
about.customerFocusedDesc: Your satisfaction is our priority. We listen to your needs and provide personalized solutions tailored to your requirements.
about.allBrandsDesc: We service all major AC and appliance brands including split units, window units, central AC systems, and commercial refrigeration.
about.competitivePricingDesc: We offer transparent, competitive pricing with no hidden charges. Quality service doesn't have to break the bank.
about.experiencedTechniciansDescOld: Certified experts for every brand and model
about.customerSatisfactionDesc: Thousands of happy customers trust our quality and support
